head: dhn  (cf. dohin دۆھِن (TF) = grease. See don. KED 201
notes:
1)Kodohnina as sefoqe du dammәr lašan d lo zәbṭi zәngoro.
Kul yawmo ono kodohanno Iḏoṯi lašan d lo nәšfi
Ono kul yawmo d konofaqno kodohanno riši.

‘‘Qәsmono gnuḥliwaynale, gsaymiwaynale ḥawdal, w guršiwaynale ha hawxa, ʕal u qalbawo, w maḥtiwayna, edi saymiwayna af fәḏre ha hawxa, mdahniwaynale..’’
The tandoor residue, we used to sieve it, we made it as ḥawdal, and we used to put a layer (of ashes), in this way, on the pattern vessel, and we used to place (it).  Then we used to put a layer of fәḏre in this way, we used to smooth it (fәḏre) 000_NE_GALA; 14:44
вскипевший виноградный сок, в который добавили муку. - grape juice thickened with flour
